status: Existing bounded mouth parts inspected before candidate selection

findings.part: Continuous split lip and fixed upper enamel
findings.capability: Opening keeps upper lip fixed and moves lower lip down by 54 * 0.55 * mouth_open source pixels. Upper teeth stay fixed at (533, 626).
findings.limitation: No independent upper-lip raising, curling or local sneer anatomy.

findings.capability: Purse narrows both contours by up to 14 source pixels per side and lowers the contour by purse * (4 + 8 * radius squared). Combined opening adds a bounded lower-lip gap.
findings.limitation: Upper and lower common contour deformation is coupled. Purse moves upper lip downward, not upward.

findings.part: Smile, spread and bilateral or independent corners
findings.capability: These controls can raise parts of the existing mouth contour.
findings.limitation: They raise both contours together and introduce smile/corner lift, not isolated upper-lip disgust. Deliberately zero.

findings.capability: Reveals up to four pixels of inferred hidden upper-lip tissue.
findings.limitation: Does not raise or curl the upper outline. Deliberately zero.

findings.capability: Moves only the independent lower oral surface.
findings.limitation: Not a lip control. Deliberately zero.

findings.capability: Existing separately authored sealed/parting mouth states.
findings.limitation: Neither supplies the specified upper-lip/lower-lip motion. Both are incompatible with positive continuous opening and remain zero.
Positive width is incompatible with positive opening. Both widths remain zero.

selected_approximation: Use symmetric ordinary eye narrowing, rigid lowered/tilted brows, continuous lower-lip opening and a moderate purse for a downturned open grimace. Preserve a distinct sealed aftertaste pose. No independent upper-lip lift or curl is implemented; no left-right lip asymmetry is authored. Native mouth shape and tooth exposure require capture review.
